concerns.text: T014a instructs the 'same Base Model' to generate both the initial answer and the critique. This violates the Plan's 'Frozen Critic Model' constraint (Technical Context) and the Spec's requirement for an 'external mechanism' (FR-002). Using the same model creates circular validation where the model critiques its own generation without independent pressure, weakening the 'negative selection' constraint.

T015b implements the ablation placeholder by repeating '[NEUTRAL]' to match token count. The Plan (Complexity Tracking) explicitly requires matching 'syntactic complexity' (sentence structure, punctuation) to control for context window complexity. Using a single repeated token fails to control for syntactic complexity, violating the ablation design constraint and risking confounded results for FR-007.

T050 requires hard-coding a 'Human-Ordered Operation' prompt header into the generation logic. The Spec and Plan define the system as an engine executing ordered operations; hard-coding a philosophical disclaimer into the prompt violates the 'Reproducibility' principle (Constitution Principle I) by making model behavior dependent on a specific prompt engineering trick rather than the algorithmic selection process, and alters data distribution without spec authorization.

T052 requires the model to output a 'Confidence Score' and 'Justification'. The Spec (FR-001/FR-002) and Plan define the critique mechanism strictly as text-based logical contradiction identification. Adding a confidence score output field creates a new data schema requirement not present in the Spec's 'Static/Dialogue/Ablation' tuple definitions, risking downstream pipeline failures and violating the defined data contract.

T054 requires extracting 'attention weights' to measure 'Attention Shift'. The Spec (FR-006) only mandates statistical comparison of *accuracy* on held-out benchmarks. Extracting internal model states is not a success criterion in the Spec and constitutes scope creep that adds significant computational overhead and complexity not authorized by the FRs, violating the constraint to isolate the effect of the selection signal via accuracy metrics only.
